title: ビジュアル表現基礎
subtitle: Visual Design Basics
keywords: Three dimensional representation 2.Space drawing 3.Digital representation 4.Spatial composition
educationalGoal: In the first half, the drawing theme is spatial representations. Students learn drawing techniques to represent structures in three dimensions from angles, directions, angles of view, and lighting. In the second half, students train their sensibilities for expressing the space with digital camera. Create an artificial space by combining these knowledge, express it as a digital image, and acquire the spatial composition ability.
advice: 1. Learn how to convert from 2D stereoscopic representation to 3D representation Students will acquire freehand drawing skills that is the basis of modeling. 2. Learn spatial (3D) composition Students learn drawing techniques to represent structures in three dimensions. 3. Learn expressions in digital images
requiredKnowledge: In the first half, students are required basic drawing skills. The assignment is given in one or two weeks. Students are required to keep deadline of the assignments.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the correlation between 2D and 3D forms and express drawings.
Be able to understand 3D expression techniques of stereo images to be created.
Be able to understand the various conditions for establishing the space as a scene.
Be able to draw spatial compositions in various perspectives
Be able to understand some techniques of emotional expression
